We need to output a proper tool call. Let's construct:

<thought>We need to search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to Friedel-Crafts acylation. The target molecule SMILES is "CNc1c(C(=O)Nc2cccc(OC)c2)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1". We'll search the template catalog with criteria indicating a halide is broken and a carbonyl is formed. Use functional_groups_broken=["halide"] and functional_groups_formed=["carbonyl"]. Also include bonds_broken=["6-6"] to capture the C-C bond broken between aromatic carbon and carbonyl carbon. This should return candidate templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CNc1c(C(=O)Nc2cccc(OC)c2)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["carbonyl"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
